info.title: gxsio-api
info.description: GraphXServer.io public API. V1 preserves PascalCase paths and the legacy tObject envelope for successful responses. Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457, `application/problem+json`) with the corresponding HTTP status.

bearer.description: An organization API key (GXS_O-...) sent as Authorization: Bearer GXS_O-...

prompt.example: Place the product on a desk in a bright modern office.

imageUrl.description: HTTPS URL of the product or mockup image

prompt.example: Place the product on a wooden desk with warm natural lighting.

message.example: The lifestyle shot could not be generated.

imageUrl.description: Signed read URL in the organization storage

generationId.description: Id of this generation, to request fresh URLs later. Missing if the record could not be saved

variations.description: Each entry has `imageUrl` or `error`, never both

code.description: `URL_SIGN_FAILED`: the image exists but a fresh URL could not be created, so retrying may work

message.example: The lifestyle shot could not be generated.

imageUrl.description: Freshly signed read URL in the organization storage

generatedCount.description: Generated and stored by the original request

variations.description: Generated variations come with a freshly signed `imageUrl`; failed ones keep their original error
